result:
Review of `main...HEAD` complete — 5 confirmed findings reported above, all verified against the code directly after an 8-angle finder sweep (line-by-line, removed-behavior, cross-file tracing, reuse, simplification, efficiency, altitude, conventions).

The short version: the two CSP changes are mechanically correct for their stated dev purpose, but the new default is fail-open on non-standard `NODE_ENV` values and the re-pinned tests no longer exercise the default path production actually uses — so the suite's own "fails loudly instead of silently shipping" promise no longer holds. The `t.between` fix stops the crash but still renders dangling "A ↔" rows for partially-streamed tuples, and the more severe sibling of the same bug (a real crash, not a flicker) is still live in `CausalGraphPanel`'s Details view.

Also worth knowing: multiple agents independently confirmed the two comment-only changes are accurate — the 25/≤15 result-cap arithmetic in `app/api/evidence-search/route.ts` checks out against `PER_QUERY_RESULTS` and `MAX_OVERRIDE_QUERIES`, and the `evidenceStore.ts` header now correctly points at the local debounced-storage adapter. A few low-value candidates (per-request micro-allocations in the proxy, duplicated test-mock preambles) were dropped as not worth acting on.
